description: Deterministic infrastructure fault injections. Each case must prove the named failure is contained or recovered without relying on an external model.

cases.test: does not publish completion when settled checkpoint commit fails
cases.invariant: A Run cannot become completed before its settled checkpoint commits.

cases.test: deduplicates the same command and reuses one execution promise
cases.invariant: At-least-once delivery does not execute the same command twice.

cases.test: retains the high-water fence after a pre-start release
cases.invariant: A released or recovered old worker cannot reacquire an obsolete fence.

cases.test: replays the exact event after a simulated commit-with-lost-ACK window
cases.invariant: A lost acknowledgement causes safe replay rather than event loss.

cases.test: fails closed when a persisted event is corrupted or a sequence file is missing
cases.invariant: Corrupt durable events are rejected rather than silently skipped.

cases.test: maps transport failures to a retryable error without leaking configuration
cases.invariant: A temporary object-store outage remains retryable and does not expose credentials.

cases.test: commits artifacts under a lease, cold-loads them, and rejects stale or corrupt state
cases.invariant: Checkpoint integrity and compare-and-swap fencing survive cold recovery.

cases.test: records cancellation as too late when natural completion wins before its ACK
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
cases.invariant: Exactly one terminal Run outcome wins a cancel/complete race.

cases.test: fences a dispatcher whose pre-ACK claim lease was superseded
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
cases.invariant: A superseded dispatcher cannot start external work.

cases.test: terminates expired and orphan runtimes before settling a lost assignment
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
cases.invariant: Expired ownership is reconciled only after the orphan runtime is terminated.

cases.test: publishes an immutable Review Bundle and atomically rewinds the latest Run
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
returns 202 only after the turn, command, and outbox record are durable
dispatches a durable command through ACK to a completed turn
cases.invariant: Rewind restores the explicit committed bases, supersedes the old projection, and creates one idempotent replacement Run.

cases.test: captures explicit bases and makes Review Bundles append-only
cases.invariant: A completed Run's content-verified Review Bundle cannot be updated or deleted.
